The designation of the Three Designated Entities requires the Commission to implement and enforce the DSA on this distinctive subset of online platforms, which possess unique characteristics compared to other designated VLOPs. 

The effective enforcement of the DSA by the Commission in relation to the designated VLOPs requires the assistance of third-party contractors to support the monitoring and supervisory work, contributing to an objective and scientific approach. The contractor should gather updated insights specifically tailored to navigate the complex ecosystem of pornographic platforms, ensuring a nuanced and effective approach in enforcing the DSA within this specific context.

Specifically, the contractual objective is to monitor the compliance of the Three Designated Entities with Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 by providing high quality data and evidence. This assistance aids the Commission in its enforcement activities, focusing particularly on four key areas of DSA compliance: 1. Content Moderation; 2. Risk Assessment; 3. Illegal Content and Practices; 4. Protection of Minors.

The contractor will be required to engage in three main research activities that will contribute to the monitoring and enforcement of the DSA obligations: 1. EU/MS Legal Framework Overview; 2. Pornographic Industry Overview with specific reference to the Three Designated Entities; 3. Creation of an Evidence Pipeline for the Analysis of Systemic Risks and Mitigation Measures to Support the Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement of the DSA. The results of these research activities will take the form of regular reports, datasets and ad hoc analyses that will support the Commission’s enforcement tasks.

The awarded contractor shall develop a clear, innovative and multifaceted methodology that encompasses the Three Designated Entities and the areas of study identified, allowing for cross-subject and cross-platform comparisons. Title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Ingenieurleistungen Ausschreibung und Bauüberwachung für den Straßenausbau Bramscher Straße 1.-3- Bauabschnitt (Julius-Schurig-Straße bis Hansastraße Süd)
Procedure title: Ingenieurleistungen Ausschreibung und Bauüberwachung für den Straßenausbau Bramscher Straße 1.-3- Bauabschnitt (Julius-Schurig-Straße bis Hansastraße Süd)
Description: Die Stadt Osnabrück beabsichtigt die Bramscher Straße auf einer Länge von rd. 1.400 m zwischen der Julius-Schurig-Straße (nördl. Teil) und der Hansastraße (Süd) auszubauen. Mit dem Straßenausbau erfolgt eine Umgestaltung und Aufwertung der Verkehrsanlage und den Nebenanlagen. Neben der grundhaften Fahrbahnerneuerung sind Rad-, Gehwege, Multifunktionsflächen, Ausstattungen, die Oberflächenentwässerung (Versickerung), Baumstandorte und die Koordinierung mit Leistungsträgern zu berücksichtigen. Den beigefügten Auszügen aus der Entwurfsplanung, einschließlich Erläuterungsbericht, sind die umzusetzenden Planungsleistungen zu entnehmen. Die Maßnahme ist in Bauabschnitt 1-2 (nördl. Teil) und Bauabschnitt 3 (südl. Teil) unter-teilt. Die Erstellung der Planung erfolgte mit dieser Unterteilung durch zwei verschiedene Ingenieurbüros. Aufgrund der unterschiedlichen Zeichnungsbeschriftungen ist bei der Durchsicht der Projektunterlagen zur Orientierung auf die Dateinamen zu achten.
Lot description: Gegenstand des Auftrags ist die örtliche Bauüberwachung zur Straßenbaumaßnahme sowie die Grundleistungen der Leistungsphasen 6, 8 und 9 gemäß §§ 45 ff. HOAI. Des Weiteren sind besondere und zusätzliche Leistungen nach Stunden-Aufwand anzubieten.

Procedure title: 9843 Design and Build Capacity Enhancement Works at Connolly Station
Description: This is a call for competition by Iarnród Éireann for the procurement of an experienced Design and Build Contractor to complete the design and deliver capacity enhancement and transformation works at Connolly Station. The project will create a new entrance from Preston Street and a passenger concourse within the historic Victorian undercroft, together with new lifts, escalators and staircases providing improved access to Platforms 5, 6 and 7. The works will also include additional emergency escape routes, public-realm improvements, retail, operational and back-of-house spaces, heritage refurbishment, structural alterations and the installation or modification of station and railway systems. The successful Contractor will be required to review and develop the reference design through detailed design to Approved for Construction status and subsequently construct, test and commission the works. The Contractor will also be responsible for providing complete as-built and handover information. The project will be delivered within a constrained, live operational railway environment. The Contractor will be required to manage passenger circulation, railway access, construction phasing, safety assurance, stakeholder engagement, heritage requirements and interfaces with other DART+ contracts. The appointed Contractor will undertake the role of Project Supervisor for the Construction Stage. The form of contract is currently anticipated to be the NEC4 Engineering and Construction Contract, Option C, target contract with activity schedule.
